1.title: Colin Gray, Father of Teenage Shooter in Georgia, Sentenced to 15 Years in Prison
1.summary: Prosecutors argued that Colin Gray bore responsibility for the 2024 shooting because he had given his son a gun and failed to act as the teen’s mental health deteriorated.

2.title: Dulles Airport’s Reviled ‘People Movers’ May Be Lurching Into the Sunset
2.summary: A $22.5 billion redesign plan eliminates the “mobile lounges,” which were conceived as a way of making air travel more efficient. Many passengers found the opposite to be true.

3.title: T.S.A. Finds 5 Civil War Cannonballs in Passenger’s Luggage in Alabama
3.summary: The inert relics, some as big as a grapefruit, were detected when agents X-rayed checked bags.

4.title: Iran War Live Updates: Saudis Form Military Alliance to Protect Red Sea Shipping
4.summary: As the war between the United States and Iran widened, Saudi Arabia joined with over a dozen other countries, including Egypt and Turkey, to form a new defense coalition to stop attacks on shipping in the Red Sea.

5.title: Hundreds of migrants swim from Morocco to Spanish enclave of Ceuta
5.summary: The territory's leader said the influx is overwhelming resources and urged the Spanish government to intervene.

6.title: Wildfires in Greece Kill 3 Firefighters as Blazes Still Burn in France and Spain
6.summary: Greece also worked to contain blazes on Lesbos and in the Peloponnese, where another firefighter died, in the midst of a brutal wildfire season for Europe.
